plan.description: State question, estimand, independent unit, assignment and primary outcome before outcomes
Freeze effect and variance assumptions, power, sample counts, allocation, attrition and unit costs
Record randomisation, blinding, allocation concealment and deterministic seeds
Hash and freeze primary family, correction, missingness, stopping and exclusion rules
Declare controls, failure handling and negative/null-result retention
Hand off all immutable stage artifacts to independent review before collection
